title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-l9ck: transcript_4 missing CRED_I per RFC 9528
description:
## Summary

The `transcript_4` function in `rust/lichen-oscore/src/edhoc.rs:462` only takes 2 arguments (`th_3`, `ciphertext_3`) but RFC 9528 Section 4.1.2 defines:

`TH_4 = H( TH_3, PLAINTEXT_3, CRED_I )`

CRED_I (the Initiator's credential) is mandatory in the TH_4 computation. Omitting it breaks spec compliance and will cause EDHOC handshake failures when interoperating with correct implementations.

## Affected code

- `fn transcript_4` at edhoc.rs:462: signature lacks `cred: &[u8]` parameter
- Caller at edhoc.rs:974 (initiator `process_message_2`): does not pass credential
- Caller at edhoc.rs:1415 (responder `finish_message_3`): does not pass `peer.credential`
- Test at edhoc.rs:1705 (`rfc9529_signature_trace_vectors`): does not pass `credential_i`

## Fix needed

1. Restore the `cred: &[u8]` parameter to `transcript_4` and add `encode_bstr(&mut buf, cred)?`
2. Rename `ciphertext_3` parameter to `plaintext_3` to match RFC usage (TH_4 uses plaintext, not ciphertext)
3. Pass the appropriate credential at both call sites
4. The EDHOC tests under `#[cfg(feature = "edhoc")]` do not currently compile (98 errors); this needs to be addressed to validate the fix

## Other changes in this commit (FRAGMENT.RS) are correct

The `from_bytes` refactoring in fragment.rs is correct: shift loop range fix (`1..body_len` → `1..=body_len`), switching from local `body` to caller `out` buffer, fixing payload to use unshifted data, and fixing ALL_1_FCN payload range.
